$comment: Merge these keys into .pi/settings.json (project or user scope). Provider-neutral — no provider/model here; the tier map owns model ids.
_defaultProjectTrust_comment: Project-local resources and the guard extension only load once trust is satisfied. Use `pi install ./adapters/pi --approve` for a one-off trusted run, or set defaultProjectTrust to "always" in a committed repo so the guard is never silently dropped. Leaving this at pi's "ask"/"never" default drops the guard extension.
